propositions: A crash after retired tombstone replacement but before live replacement leaves the same exact identity in both retired and live state, detectable but not safely repairable at construction or preview time.

Incomplete-operation recovery must be invoked at the validated write-bearing reconcile boundary after the under-lock staleness gate and before the first remote issue fetch, using only local binding state.
Recovery must require exact agreement of local id and Jira key across tombstone, forward entry, and reverse entry; mismatch or corruption triggers safety-abort without write.

Explicit unretire removes the tombstone and prevents completion; later automatic confirmation via 200 status, clear_absent, or same-key bind_confirm does not implicitly resurrect a tombstoned identity.
Production code must not mutate bindings obtained through all_bindings(); rich-text emission must use the narrow facade operation.
The pre-observation repair window exists in reconcile.py after staleness validation, not in run_differs.py, and invocation is a single guarded call line in the spine.
